title: HF3498 (2025-2026 Regular): Penalty for transferring a firearm to an unauthorized person increased, mandatory minimum sentence for certain transfers of a firearm to an ineligible person established, and affirmative defense removed.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2026-02-19; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2026/0/HF/3498/versions/0/)
provenance.note: As-filed text, introduced 2026-02-19. Section 1 strikes the old two-year maximum. Section 3 repeals subd. 4, the affirmative defense for a family or household member who transferred under compulsion.

Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 624.7141, subd. 2): A person sentenced under this subdivision shall be committed to the commissioner of corrections for not less than three years or the presumptive fixed sentence under the Minnesota Sentencing Guidelines, whichever is greater.
